content_sections.heading: ANDUAT Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: ANDUAT has advertised 12 vacancies across 11 posts. Every vacancy is in the Unreserved (UR) category as printed in the notification. Abbreviations used: UR = Unreserved, SC = Scheduled Caste, ST = Scheduled Tribe, OBC = Other Backward Class, EWS = Economically Weaker Section, PWD = Person with Disability. The horizontal reservation for PWD, dependents of freedom fighters will be applied as per Uttar Pradesh State Government rules, i.e. no. 3/2021/324/2021/65-3-2021-78/99T.C. dated 30-7-2021. Acid Attacked Victims (AAV), Dwarfism (Dw) and Lower Vision (LV) will be given weightage. The reservation policy will be adopted as per Government of Uttar Pradesh rules, wherever applicable.

content_sections.text: The notification says age, qualification and other conditions will be determined as on the closing date, i.e. 05.11.2026. Candidates should apply early, as the university will not be responsible for postal delay.

content_sections.heading: ANDUAT Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Eligibility depends on the post applied for. All applicants must meet the essential requirements, and the notification says meeting them does not by itself entitle a candidate to be called for a test or interview. Persons convicted by a court, or against whom criminal proceedings are pending, and persons who are not citizens of India are not eligible. Candidates holding degrees or diplomas from institutions declared fake by the UGC are also not eligible. Candidates who contracted a marriage while having a living spouse (or married a person having a living spouse) are ineligible, unless the competent authority exempts them as the notification provides. Any other category disqualified by the Government of India/DARE/ICAR from time to time is also ineligible.

content_sections.heading: ANDUAT Application Fee
content_sections.text: The fee must be paid by Demand Draft in favour of "Comptroller, Acharya Narendra Deva University of Agriculture & Technology, Kumarganj, Ayodhya-224 229", payable at SBI, ANDUAT, Branch PITHLA (IFSC 06925). The demand draft should be attached with the application form. Bank charges in addition to the specified fee are to be borne by the candidate. Fee once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances. No concession of application fee is admissible to SC/ST candidates of other states. Candidates applying for more than one post must submit a separate form, in a separate envelope, with the fee for each post.

content_sections.heading: ANDUAT Salary
content_sections.text: The notification gives pay scales, grade pay and pay matrix levels only. It does not state a monthly salary figure. Service conditions, including pay level and age of superannuation, will be as per University/ICAR rules and Government of Uttar Pradesh rules.

content_sections.heading: ANDUAT Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection will be completed in two phases: Phase I: Screening of application forms and assigning weightage to applicants, and finalisation of the shortlist. A specially constituted committee will screen the forms, giving weightage to academic qualification and experience as mentioned. Phase II: Personal interaction/interview by the selection committee. If a large number of applications is received, the university is free to conduct a written exam/skill test to shortlist applications. The process may be a Qualifying Test/Written Test/Skill Test/Domain Knowledge Test or a combination. The lists of shortlisted candidates and test details will be published only on the university website. The university does not pay travel expenses for attending the interview. A Hindi note in the notification states, in summary, that interview call letters will be issued on merit: up to 10 times the vacancies for one post and up to 5 times for each subsequent post, along with candidates scoring equal to the last candidate (this is a plain-language reading; refer to the original Hindi note). Increase or decrease posts under any category, or not fill any advertised position. Withdraw any advertised post at any time without assigning a reason. Draw reserve panels against possible future vacancies. Offer a post at a lower level than advertised, depending on qualifications, experience and performance. Fix criteria for screening applications, conduct qualifying/written tests where none is prescribed, and relax age/qualifications/experience at its discretion.

faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting organization for NDUAT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Acharya Narendra Deva University of Agriculture & Technology (NDUAT), located in Kumarganj, Ayodhya, Uttar Pradesh, to fill various administrative and academic positions.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available in this notification?
faq.answer: There are a total of 12 vacancies available across various posts including Registrar, Librarian, Director Work & Plant, Engineers, and other administrative roles.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the offline application form?
faq.answer: The last date for the submission of the completed offline application form along with required documents and demand draft is 5 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode for NDUAT Various Posts Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly offline. Candidates must download the application form, fill it out, attach necessary enclosures, and send it via Speed or Registered Post.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for UR and OBC candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for Unreserved (UR), OBC, and EWS category candidates is Rs. 1500/-, while for SC, ST, and PWD candidates it is Rs. 750/-.

faq.question: Q6. What qualifications are required for the Registrar post?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Registrar post must hold a Post Graduate degree with at least 55% marks, coupled with extensive administrative or teaching experience as specified in the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any age limit specified for these positions?
faq.answer: Yes, the age limit is 18 to 40 years for Serial Numbers 1 to 5, with standard relaxations for reserved categories. There is no age limit specified for Serial Numbers 6 to 12.

faq.question: Q8. Where should I send the filled application form?
faq.answer: The application form must be sent by Registered or Speed Post to the Director, Administration and Monitoring, Acharya Narendra Deva University of Agriculture & Technology, Kumarganj, Ayodhya, (U.P.) 224 229.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for NDUAT recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises screening of application forms and assigning academic weightage, followed by qualifying written or skill tests (if applicable), and personal interaction or interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I download the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: Candidates can download the official notification and application form directly from the university's official website at www.nduat.org or via the direct links provided in this article.
